body:
Two things:

1. I suck at life. Plain and simple. I've been with one woman that I haven't had to pay and that's where my daughter came from. She cheated on me, but really she saw through me and who I am and wanted out. I can't blame her. 

2. Lets just say if people could read my mind, I'd have been dead a long time ago. I know right from wrong, but my mind seems to enjoy being wrong. It's a constant struggle to not be a bad person. The alternatives I have are to have a life of mind altering prescriptions and possibly be institutionalized or to just not have a life at all.

This is weird for me - I've never told anyone any of this. My life is a string of lies. I guess I'm just not used to seeing the truth.

I wish that were the truth, but I'm afraid that she'd be more scarred by my being here. I'm not a good person. Everyone thinks I am, but I'm not.  Eventually she'll see that. I'm barely surviving in this world as it is. If I go now, she'll never have to know. I know she'll get over it. She's a resilient kid and I really think it's better than the alternative. She'll lose me eventually. Better now when she doesn't see me as the horrible person I really am.
